description: Where the shared blocks installed in a project came from, in `jevision.blocks.json` in the project folder, so the whole team can update them. JEVision keeps it itself.

$schema.description: Address of this schema, so that editors check the file and suggest its keys.

format.description: Version of the layout of the file. JEVision doesn't open a file in a format newer than it knows.

minVersion.description: The oldest JEVision that can open the file, such as 1.4.0. An older one asks to be updated instead of opening it.

sources.description: The address each package was installed from, by its id. A package installed from a file has none.

versions.description: The version each package had when it was installed, by its id.

title: JEVision installed blocks
